docs.title: ITS Ontology - Transport User Topic Area
docs.text:
This ontology imports the Transport User topic area modules.

License: http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

The ITS Ontology - Transport User Topic Area consists of the following patterns:

  • Core
  • Transport User

The formal definition of this ontology is available in TURTLE Syntax.

docs.title: Transport User Core Pattern
docs.text:
This ontology defines patterns for core concepts within the Transport User Topic Area.

This pattern imports the following files:

  • https://w3id.org/citydata/part1/v1/
  • https://w3id.org/itsdata/core/v1/

This pattern consists of the following classes:

  • Transport User Thing This module defines the following properties:

  • TransportUserDataProperty

  • TransportUserObjectProperty

The formal definition of this pattern is available in TURTLE Syntax.

docs.title: TransportUsageTypeCode
docs.text:
A code that indicates the type of transport usage.

EXAMPLE: HOV2, hired taxi, etc.

docs.title: Diagram
docs.text:
SVG (interactive)PNG

cluster_associated its-core_Code its-core:Code TransportUserThing TransportUserThing TransportUsageTypeCode TransportUsageTypeCode TransportUsageTypeCode->its-core_Code TransportUsageTypeCode->TransportUserThing

docs.title: Formalization for TransportUsageTypeCode
docs.text: Property Constraint subClassOf TransportUserThing subClassOf its-core:Code

docs.title: Transport User Pattern
docs.text:
This ontology defines patterns for transport user.

This pattern imports the following files:

  • https://w3id.org/citydata/part1/v1/
  • https://w3id.org/itsdata/core/v1/

This pattern consists of the following classes:

  • Transport Usage Type Code
  • Transport User Type Code

The formal definition of this pattern is available in TURTLE Syntax in two files, the core semantics and the SHACL restrictions.

docs.title: TransportUserThing
docs.text: Parent class for transport user domain concepts.

docs.title: Specializations of TransportUserThing
docs.text: Class Description Transport Usage Type Code A code that indicates the type of transport usage. Transport User Type Code A code that indicates the type of transport user.

docs.title: TransportUserTypeCode
docs.text:
A code that indicates the type of transport user.

EXAMPLE: passenger, pedestrian, cyclist, vehicle, sheep, etc.

docs.title: Diagram
docs.text:
SVG (interactive)PNG

cluster_associated its-core_Code its-core:Code TransportUserThing TransportUserThing TransportUserTypeCode TransportUserTypeCode TransportUserTypeCode->its-core_Code TransportUserTypeCode->TransportUserThing

docs.title: Formalization for TransportUserTypeCode
docs.text: Property Constraint subClassOf TransportUserThing subClassOf its-core:Code

docs.title: TransportUserDataProperty
docs.text:
Organizational super-property for transport user core data properties.

IRI: https://w3id.org/itsdata/t-user/v1/TransportUserDataProperty

docs.title: TransportUserObjectProperty
docs.text:
Organizational super-property for transport user core object properties.

IRI: https://w3id.org/itsdata/t-user/v1/TransportUserObjectProperty
